dataset.principle: nonce fictional entities and codes are used so acquisition cannot be credited to pretrained world knowledge

decision.formal_support: at least 2 of 3 untouched formal seeds pass
decision.freeze_rule: after the first formal seed starts, no scientific gate, threshold, dataset identity, model revision, seed, training rule, or evaluation rule may change

evaluation.branch_merge: train two rewrites from the same formation snapshot on distinct primary Cells, require each standalone branch to acquire the semantic mapping, merge Cell-scoped states, then require semantic mapping retention plus exact rollback
evaluation.candidate_choice_semantics: for each heldout question, teacher-force every registered nonce candidate without EOS supervision; the reference mapping is correct only when its answer-token NLL is strictly lower than every incorrect candidate
evaluation.growth: compare parent-only conflict update with parent+child contextual specialization; growth is supported only if parent-only fails the registered conflict solution while the spawned child satisfies acquisition and retention
evaluation.semantic_write: rewrite one entity using only its pre-formation primary Cell and test unseen rewrite wording, candidate-choice semantics, and unrelated entities
evaluation.spawn_invariance: child spawn must be function-preserving before child specialization, measured by reference NLL and candidate-choice margin invariance

followup_boundary.if_not_supported: classify failure by compatibility, formation, semantic choice, routing, local write, growth necessity, branch composition, or rollback; do not repair thresholds post-hoc
followup_boundary.if_supported: freeze a conversion substrate release candidate, then run matched LoRA/static-routed-adapter baselines and only afterward return to JAM domain mutation

scientific_question: Can a frozen mature MoE grow persistent, semantically addressable, independently mutable functional Cells without first treating pretrained Expert/channel boundaries as Cells?

sequence_task.answer_policy: evaluation answers are nonce semantic values, not shared correctness prefixes

substrate.compatibility_invariant: before Cell learning every residual transform is exactly zero, so the converted path must match foundation output up to measured forward repeatability
substrate.definition: Cell = shared semantic read key plus reusable low-rank residual transform at multiple later transformer layers
substrate.initialization: read keys and down factors seeded; all up factors exactly zero
substrate.routing_rule: read once at the first registered layer; reuse the same sparse route at every registered write layer in that forward

title: CLM Conversion Kill Test 001 — Mature MoE Functional Cellization

formation.checkpoint_rule: best validation NLL gain among candidates satisfying the registered history KL ceiling; final direct/negation/relation heldout families and all candidate-choice metrics are never used for checkpoint selection

growth.child_initialization: copy parent key and transforms so spawning is initially function-preserving, then train child only
growth.route_learning: child read key may learn only during conflict specialization
growth.trigger: scaffolded post-hoc conflict trigger; learned growth control is not under test in this experiment

local_mutation.rule: only one registered Cell transform may receive nonzero gradients; read key stays frozen except for a newly spawned child
